item.title: Noroi no Yakata no Shokushukutsu
item.description:

  • 発売日: 2003-08-12
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 呪いの館の触手窟
  • 英語名: Noroi no Yakata no Shokushukutsu

别名

  • The Tentacle Cave Beneath The Haunted House

あらすじ

A girl from an anti-alien special force is captured by the enemy commander with the alien’s awful paralyzing beam.

In the alien’s headquarters, she is tortured with whips, electricity, remote control vibrator, and a tentacle-machine.

She struggles to escape, but finally she is taken to a cave where biomechanical monsters crawl…

别名

  • THE INCREDIBLE MAN-EATING TENTACLES!

あらすじ

An adventure of a superheroine fighting against invaders from outer space!

A Japanese Sentai superheroine encounters a monster with awful tentacles. She is captured in a trap and tortured in the alien’s headquarters. Once she escapes, the monster attacks her again with its tentacle and slime!!
